question: Vaibhav Suryavanshi smashes fastest known century against hosts England in Youth ODIs. How many balls did Vaibhav take to score his century?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**52**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Vaibhav Suryavanshi smashes fastest known century against hosts England in Youth ODIs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Vaibhav Suryavanshi**, a **14-year-old Indian cricketer**, smashed the **fastest century in Youth ODIs**.

 
 
• 
 
He scored a **century in just 52 balls** against **England** in **Worcester**.

 
 
• 
 
His explosive knock included **13 fours** and **10 sixes**.

 
 
• 
 
He shared a **219-run partnership** for the **second wicket** with **Vihaan Malhotra**.

 
 
• 
 
**Vihaan Malhotra** remained **unbeaten on 100**.
